_source.review: 50-state + DC review of state laws requiring local governments to allow, by right or ministerially: ADUs, middle housing on single-family lots, lot splits, parking-minimum limits, residential use on commercial land
_source.method: Primary text only as evidence (legislature sites, session laws, official code); quotes cut from fetched pages by scripts/add_state_laws_50.py
_source.limits: Candidate discovery was not exhaustive: secondary pages plus a known-reform list, with full-text code searches only where noted. 'none_found' means no candidate was found, not that none exists.

round2.method: scripts/search_zoning_chapters.py full-text searched each 'none found' state's zoning-enabling chapter(s) on the official code site; scripts/add_state_laws_n3b.py added what was found and wrote these notes. Search engines (legiscan, Justia search, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Mojeek) blocked automated queries; Bing's results were not used because its terms forbid it.
round2.limits: Only the zoning-enabling chapters were searched, and only where the state's site returned statute text; a law codified elsewhere, or enacted but not yet on the state's site, would be missed.

round3.scope: the 23 states whose code sites blocked round 2, plus NH, CT, DC and Maryland HB 538
